chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The one who eats a pomegranate upon the empty stomach, illuminates his heart for forty days.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of eating a pomegranate on an empty stomach according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the consumption of pomegranate on an empty stomach to a forty-day illumination of the heart, reflecting the Shia tradition of viewing physical sustenance as a means to spiritual clarity. This specific virtue underscores the holistic view of health in Shia jurisprudence, where dietary habits are seen as directly influencing the state of the soul and spiritual receptivity.
